_comment: Frozen beat-boundary window of bars 7-8 of the shipped cue assets/audio/pp_04_fight_baroque_v2/pp_04_fight_baroque_v2.mid, which is the studio's own M3 build (three voice fugue exposition on the game's leitmotif, A minor, 4/4, 168 bpm; see that folder's NOTES.md), so no third party music is involved. The cue MIDI is gitignored by repo policy (.gitignore:103 *.mid), so the sampled pitches live here instead of being read from the file at import: a clean clone must still collect and run the adversarial suite. test_shipped_repertoire_fixture_is_still_the_committed_cue re-derives the same window from the MIDI when that file is present and fails if this copy has drifted.
sampling: max sounding pitch per voice at each of the eight beat boundaries
